description: Look up a Statistics Norway (SSB) KLASS classification (code list) and its correspondences, valid at a date or year. Answers e.g. "which KOSTRA group is Bergen in, 2025?" (id 112 = KOSTRA municipality groups, mapped to id 131 = municipalities by default) and lists all municipalities in a county (code_prefix "46" = Vestland) with their KOSTRA group for each of several years. Other ids: 131 municipalities, 104 counties. Without id lists classifications. Unknown id returns found:false. Source: Statistics Norway (SSB), KLASS classification service.

code.description: Match one code on either side, e.g. "4601" (Bergen) or "EKG12".

code_prefix.description: Match codes starting with this on either side, e.g. "46" for Vestland municipalities.

id.description: KLASS classification id, e.g. 112 (KOSTRA groups), 131 (municipalities). Omit to list classifications.

target_id.description: Target classification for correspondences (default 131 when id is 112). Omit for a plain code list.

year.description: Year; resolves to 1 January of that year. Default: today.

years.description: Several years in one call (max 10), e.g. [2023,2024,2025].

name: ssb_no_classification
title: Ssb No Classification
